## What's new
- **`Config\site.json` now ships blank.** The file in the zip no longer contains any organization's IP range: `highlightIpPrefixes` is empty, so IP addresses in PC Details are not coloured until you add your own ranges.

## Upgrading from v6.0.0
- Extract the new zip into the folder and keep your own `Config` files, including your `site.json`.
- If you take `site.json` from this zip instead, add your ranges to `highlightIpPrefixes` (for example `[ "10.99." ]`) to get the orange IP colouring back, then restart the app.

## Download & run
Download `HelpDeskProTools-v6.0.1-win-x64-self-contained.zip`, extract it, run `HelpDeskProTools.exe` and log in with your admin account.

This build is **self-contained**: .NET is included, so nothing needs to be installed on the PC. It runs as-is from a local folder or a file share.
